item.title: Dorchester County Announces December and New Years Day Closures
item.description: Dorchester County has announced closures for the upcoming holidays. See below for details.

item.title: The Society of Bluffton Artists Announces “Large Art” Exhibition, January 5–February 2
item.description: The Society of Bluffton Artists (SOBA) invites the public to experience “Large Art,” a bold and visually striking exhibition running January 5 through February 2 at the SOBA Gallery, located at 6 Church Street in Old Town Bluffton.

item.title: Wild Common Executive Chef Orlando Pagán, Scoundrel Executive Chef Joe Cash Announce Two-Night Dinner Series
item.description: Two of the American South’s most celebrated chefs, Orlando Pagán of Wild Common and Joe Cash of Scoundrel, will come together this January for a rare two-night collaborative dinner series

item.title: Emeline Hotel Debuts ‘Golden Year of Christmas’ Holiday Experience
item.description: Now through Jan. 5, Emeline’s private dining room, The Den, glows with its Golden Year of Christmas — an alpine-inspired, gold-accented space serving inventive holiday cocktails that reimagine seasonal classics.

item.title: Early Bird Tickets on Sale Now for the East Cooper Luxury Home Tour
item.description: Charleston Home + Design Magazine and the Charleston Home Builders Association are hosting the first ever East Cooper Luxury Home Tour presented by Carolina Machine Finishing on Friday, January 30, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

item.title: The 22nd Annual Charleston Home + Design Show Returns in January 2026
item.description: Mark your calendars for the 22nd Annual Charleston Home + Design Show, happening Friday, Jan. 30, through Sunday, Feb. 1. The weekend kicks off with the East Cooper Luxury Home Tour and an opening night party at 176 Patriots Point Blvd.

item.title: International African American Museum Unveils ‘The Renewal Series’ to Honor African Diasporic Winter Traditions
item.description: The International African American Museum (IAAM) announces the launch of “The Renewal Series,” an annual winter programming series shaped by cultural practices found across the African Diaspora.

item.title: Barrier Island EcoTours to Host Women's Coastal Skills Workshop on Jan. 31
item.description: Barrier Island EcoTours (BIET), a locally owned Isle of Palms ecotour company, is excited to host its first-ever women’s coastal skills workshop on Saturday, Jan. 31 from 12:30 to 6 p.m.

item.title: College of Charleston President Andrew T. Hsu Recognized as Top-Performing Leader
item.description: President Andrew T. Hsu is being celebrated as one of the most influential leaders shaping the educational landscape in the Palmetto State, earning a spot on the South Carolina 500 list in the Education category.

item.title: Are game shows the future of table play?
item.description: The online casino industry has expanded significantly in recent years, and one of the more noticeable developments is the rise of game show-style live games. Many of these titles are featured among the Sky Vegas new games and differ from traditional table games such as Blackjack, Roulette, or Baccarat, both in presentation and format. With brightly lit studios, live hosts, and a broader range of outcomes, they’ve carved out a distinct category within live casino offerings.
